evidence_excerpts: necessity: if [p] is (fully) grounded in D, then ☐(∧D → p).
(1) Suppose that [p] is (fully) grounded in D. ... (5) By (3) and (4), ☐(∧D → p).
text: If a fact [p] is fully grounded in a plurality of facts D, then it is metaphysically necessary that the conjunction of propositions corresponding to D entails p.
